Class CraftTweakerMolecules.Fragment

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.compat.crafttweaker.CraftTweakerMolecules.Fragment
Enclosing class:
CraftTweakerMolecules
public static final class CraftTweakerMolecules.Fragment extends Object
Reusable fragment authoring handle. The real StructureBuilder owns validation and immutable snapshots. Coordinates are in angstroms. Attachments name atoms; they never move or chemically modify them.
